description.en: The ID of the SAP HANA instance.

description.zh:
是否包括差异备份。
- true：包括差异备份
- false：不包括差异备份
description.en:
Specifies whether to include differential backups in the query results. Valid values:

*   true: includes differential backups.
*   false: excludes differential backups.

description.zh:
是否包括增量备份。
- true：包括增量备份
- false：不包括增量备份
description.en:
Specifies whether to include incremental backups in the query results. Valid values:

*   true: includes incremental backups.
*   false: excludes incremental backups.

description.zh:
是否包括日志备份。
- true：包括日志备份
- false：不包括日志备份
description.en:
Specifies whether to include log backups in the query results. Valid values:

*   true: includes log backups.
*   false: excludes log backups.

description.zh: 日志位置，仅选择**RECOVERY\_TO\_LOG\_POSITION**恢复方式时有效。
description.en: The log position to which you want to restore the database. This parameter is valid only if you set the Mode parameter to **RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION**.

description.zh:
恢复方式。
- **RECOVERY\_TO\_MOST\_RECENT**： 最近时间，将数据库恢复到已备份的最近可用状态。
- **RECOVERY\_TO\_POINT\_IN\_TIME**：指定时间，将数据库恢复到特定时间点。
- **RECOVERY\_TO\_SPECIFIC\_BACKUP**：指定备份，将数据库恢复到指定的数据库备份。
- **RECOVERY\_TO\_LOG\_POSITION**：日志位置，将数据库还原到指定日志位置。
description.en:
The recovery mode. Valid values:

*   **RECOVERY_TO_MOST_RECENT**: restores the database to the recently available state to which the database has been backed up.
*   **RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME**: restores the database to a specified point in time.
*   **RECOVERY_TO_SPECIFIC_BACKUP**: restores the database to a specified backup.
*   **RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION**: restores the database to a specified log position.

description.zh: 分页页码，从1开始，默认值为1。
description.en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页大小，最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 99. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 选择需要恢复到的时间点。仅选择**RECOVERY\_TO\_POINT\_IN\_TIME**恢复方式时有效，系统会将数据库恢复到离这个时间最近的状态。
description.en: The point in time to which you want to restore the database. This parameter is valid only if you set the Mode parameter to **RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME**. Cloud Backup restores the database to a state closest to the specified point in time.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh: 源系统名。表示需要恢复的源数据库名，格式为`源数据库名@SID`。
description.en: The name of the source system. This parameter specifies the name of the source database that you want to restore. You must set the parameter in the `<Source database name>@SID` format.
The ID of the source SAP HANA instance.

description.zh:
是否是跨实例恢复。

- true：跨实例恢复
- false：非跨实例恢复
description.en:
Specifies whether to restore the database to a different instance.

*   true: restores the database to a different instance.
*   false: restores the database within the same instance.

description.zh:
是否使用Backint。
- true：使用Backint
- false：不使用Backint
description.en:
Specifies whether Backint is used. Valid values:

*   true: Backint is used.
*   false: Backint is not used.
The ID of the backup vault.

description.zh: 要恢复的Volume ID。仅选择**RECOVERY\_TO\_LOG\_POSITION**恢复方式时有效。
description.en: The ID of the volume that you want to restore. This parameter is valid only if you set the Mode parameter to **RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION**.

title.zh: 查询符合条件的SAP HANA备份

descriptions.zh: 调用DescribeHanaBackupsAsync查询符合条件的SAP HANA备份后，请调用DescribeTask接口查询最终结果。
descriptions.en: After you call the DescribeHanaBackupsAsync operation to query the SAP HANA backups that meet the specified conditions, call the DescribeTask operation to query the final result.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbr describe-hana-backups-async --vault-id v-000270c000000pi81 --cluster-id cl-00098000000yuqvu --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --database-name BPD --biz-mode RECOVERY_TO_SPECIFIC_BACKUP --recovery-point-in-time 1649851200 --log-position 0 --volume-id 0 --system-copy true --source P01@HP1 --source-cluster-id cl-0000g3m0000005cj --include-differential false --include-incremental true --include-log true --use-backint false --resource-group-id rg-acfmz7mced2ldhy --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun hbr DescribeHanaBackupsAsync --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmz7mced2ldhy' --ClusterId 'cl-00098000000yuqvu' --Mode RECOVERY_TO_SPECIFIC_BACKUP --DatabaseName BPD --VaultId 'v-000270c000000pi81' --Source 'P01@HP1' --RecoveryPointInTime 1649851200 --VolumeId 0 --PageNumber 1 --IncludeDifferential false --IncludeLog true --SourceClusterId 'cl-0000g3m0000005cj' --UseBackint false --LogPosition 0 --SystemCopy true --IncludeIncremental true
